title: The cokernel of a map from a module of finite type into a finitely presented module is finitely presented
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the cokernel of a map from a module of finite type into a finitely presented module is again finitely presented (author lemma at source lines 1648-1655, label lemma-cokernel-finite-finite-presentation). The proof (source lines 1657-1671) writes the module locally as a quotient of a finite direct sum by a finite type submodule, identifies the image of the given map with the quotient of a larger submodule, uses that this image is of finite type and the context lemma to conclude that the larger submodule is of finite type, and reads off finite presentation of the cokernel (proof lines 1658-1670). The reduction to a statement about submodules of a finite free module is the content. H2.
